question: Whom does the attainer of Brahma's world protect among caṇḍālas and all remaining beings?
premises: The figure has attained Brahma's world
The figure acts as their protector
inference: The attainer of Brahma's world serves as protector for caṇḍālas and all other beings
plain_english: Having attained the world of Brahma, he is the protector of caṇḍālas and all other beings.
